title: cyperus helvus
intro: Cyperus helvus, commonly known as black sedge or yellow papyrus, is a type of aquatic plant that belongs to the sedge family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and treat digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Cyperus helvus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial properties. The plant's bioactive constituents work together to provide a range of health benefits, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
